## Instructions

This document assumes that you have completed the instructions [here](https://github.com/iangow/era_pl_templates/blob/main/README.md).

The fraud detection application requires WRDS data (`funda` from Compustat).
The AAER outcome data (`aaer_firm_year`, `aaer_dates`) are bundled with the `era_pl` package and require no WRDS access.

This template extracts the visible code and exercises from [Chapter 26](https://iangow.github.io/era_pl_book/prediction.html) of the Python Polars edition of *Empirical Research in Accounting: Tools and Methods*.
This template includes all the code from the book chapter.

Note that the ensemble grid searches in the `## Ensemble methods` section take a long time to run and are marked `#| eval: false`.
The exercises do not require you to run those cells.
If you wish to run them interactively, do so before attempting the testing section exercises.

Within Positron, you can run the code below in two ways.

In the first way, you can treat this file as a notebook of sorts and just run the code interactively.

You might choose to go through the cells in order and click "Run Cell" on each one to see its output.
Alternatively, you might jump ahead to a cell of interest, and click "Run Above" so that any prior code needed for your chosen cell has been executed, then "Run Cell" on the cell of interest.

Note that some cells contain multiple lines and to see the output from each, you may need to execute them one at a time.
You can run code interactively from a .qmd file in Positron without rendering the whole document.

In the second way, you have Quarto "render" the document as PDF.

Other chunk options include `#| echo` to show or hide the code and `#| output` to hide or show the output.

```{python}
features = (
    funda

    .drop_nulls()
    .sort("gvkey", "datadate")
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
aaer_long = (
    aaer_firm_year
    .with_columns(fyear=pl.int_ranges("min_year",
                                      pl.col("max_year") + 1))
    .explode("fyear")
    .select("gvkey", "p_aaer", "fyear",
            "min_year", "max_year")
)

def get_aaers(
    test_date: str,
    include_latent: bool = False,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    min_aaer_date = aaer_dates["aaer_date"].min()
    test_date = np.datetime64(test_date)
    out = (
        aaer_dates
        .with_columns(p_aaer=pl.col("aaer_num")
                             .str.replace(r"^AAER-", ""))
        .select("p_aaer", "aaer_date")
        .unique()
        .join(aaer_long, on="p_aaer", how="right")
        .with_columns(
            aaer_date=pl.col("aaer_date")
            .fill_null(min_aaer_date)
        )
        .with_columns(
            misstate=pl.col("aaer_date") <= pl.lit(test_date)
        )
        .select("gvkey", "fyear", "misstate")
        .unique()
    )
    if include_latent:
        return out.with_columns(misstate_latent=True)
    return out

aaers = get_aaers(test_date="2002-09-30", include_latent=True)
```

```{python}
# Logit cross-validation — students write their own version in Q2.
def logit_predict(fold: int) -> pl.DataFrame:
    dft = data_train.join(sample_splits, on="gvkey", how="inner")
    train = dft.filter(pl.col("fold") != fold)
    test = dft.filter(pl.col("fold") == fold)
    model = LogisticRegression(max_iter=5000)
    model.fit(
        train.select(X_vars).to_pandas(),
        train[y_var].cast(pl.Int8).to_numpy(),
    )
    return (
        test
        .select("gvkey", "fyear")
        .with_columns(
            score=predict_proba_series(model, test.select(X_vars))
        )
        .with_columns(
            predicted=(pl.col("score") > 0.5).cast(pl.Int8)
        )
    )

logit_fit = (
    pl.concat([logit_predict(fold) for fold in folds], how="vertical")
    .join(data_train.select("gvkey", "fyear", "misstate"),
          on=["gvkey", "fyear"], how="inner")
    .select("gvkey", "fyear", "predicted", "score", "misstate")
)
confusion_matrix(
    logit_fit["misstate"],
    logit_fit["predicted"],
)
roc_auc_score(
    logit_fit["misstate"],
    logit_fit["score"],
)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
def rus_predict(fold: int, **kwargs) -> pl.DataFrame:
    dft = (
        data_train
        .join(sample_splits, on="gvkey", how="inner")
        .with_columns(misstate=pl.col("misstate").cast(pl.Int8))
    )
    train = dft.filter(pl.col("fold") != fold)
    test = dft.filter(pl.col("fold") == fold)
    fm = rusboost(train, features=X_vars, target="misstate", **kwargs)
    return (
        test
        .select("gvkey", "fyear")
        .with_columns(prob=predict_proba_series(fm, test.select(X_vars), name="prob"))
        .with_columns(
            predicted=(pl.col("prob") > 0.5).cast(pl.Int8)
        )
    )

def get_auc(**kwargs) -> float:
    try:
        parts = [rus_predict(fold, **kwargs) for fold in folds]
        rus_fit = (
            pl.concat(parts, how="vertical")
            .join(
                data_train.select("gvkey", "fyear", "misstate"),
                on=["gvkey", "fyear"],
                how="inner",
            )
            .select("gvkey", "fyear", "predicted", "prob", "misstate")
        )
        return float(
            roc_auc_score(
                rus_fit["misstate"],
                rus_fit["prob"],
            )
        )
    except ValueError:
        return 0.5

def tune_boost_grid(params: list[dict]) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return pl.DataFrame(
        [{**param, "auc": get_auc(**param)} for param in params]
    )
```

```{python}
keys_ada = {

    dict(zip(keys_ada.keys(), values))
    for values in itertools.product(*keys_ada.values())
]

with ptime():

optim_ada = adaboost_results.filter(pl.col("auc") == pl.col("auc").max())
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
test_years = list(range(2003, 2009))
test_dates = (
    pl.DataFrame({"test_year": test_years})
    .with_columns(
        test_date=pl.date(pl.col("test_year") + 1, 9, 30)
    )
)

def train_model(
    features: pl.DataFrame,
    test_year: int,
    gap: int = 2,
    size: int = 30,
    rus: bool = True,
    learn_rate: float = 1.0,
    ir: float = 1.0,
    maxdepth: int | None = None,
    minbucket: int | None = None,
):
    test_date = (
        test_dates
        .filter(pl.col("test_year") == test_year)
        .select("test_date")
        .item()
    )
    aaers_local = get_aaers(test_date=str(test_date))
    data_train_local = (
        aaers_local
        .join(features, on=["gvkey", "fyear"], how="right")
        .filter(pl.col("fyear") <= (test_year - gap))
        .with_columns(
            misstate=pl.col("misstate").fill_null(False).cast(pl.Int8)
        )
    )
    return rusboost(
        data_train_local,
        features=X_vars,
        target="misstate",
        size=size,
        rus=rus,
        learn_rate=learn_rate,
        ir=ir,
        maxdepth=maxdepth,
        minbucket=minbucket,
    )

def test_model(features: pl.DataFrame, fm, test_year: int):
    df = (
        features
        .join(
            aaer_long.select("gvkey", "fyear", "p_aaer"),
            on=["gvkey", "fyear"],
            how="left",
        )
        .with_columns(
            misstate=pl.col("p_aaer").is_not_null().cast(pl.Int8)
        )
    )
    data_test = df.filter(pl.col("fyear") == test_year)
    score = predict_proba_series(
        fm,
        data_test.select(X_vars),
        name="score",
    ).to_numpy()
    predicted = (score > 0.5).astype(np.int8)
    response = data_test["misstate"].to_numpy()
    return {"score": score, "predicted": predicted, "response": response}

def fit_test(
    x: int,
    features: pl.DataFrame,
    gap: int = 2,
    size: int = 30,
    rus: bool = True,
    learn_rate: float = 1.0,
    ir: float = 1.0,
    maxdepth: int | None = None,
    minbucket: int | None = None,
):
    fm = train_model(
        features=features,
        test_year=x,
        size=size,
        rus=rus,
        ir=ir,
        learn_rate=learn_rate,
        gap=gap,
        maxdepth=maxdepth,
        minbucket=minbucket,
    )
    return test_model(features=features, fm=fm, test_year=x)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
def get_stats(results):
    response = np.asarray(results["response"], dtype=float)
    score = np.asarray(results["score"], dtype=float)
    auc_val = roc_auc_score(response, score)
    n = max(len(score), 1)
    ks = [max(1, int(round(p * n))) for p in (0.01, 0.02, 0.03)]
    ndcgs = [float(ndcg_score([response], [score], k=k)) for k in ks]
    return [float(auc_val), *ndcgs]

def add_means(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    mean_row = df.select(pl.all().mean())
    return pl.concat([df, mean_row], how="vertical")

def table_results(results):
    stat_rows = [get_stats(res) for res in results]
    base = pl.DataFrame(
        stat_rows,
        schema=["AUC", "NDCG@1%", "NDCG@2%", "NDCG@3%"],
        orient="row",
    )
    out = add_means(base).with_columns(
        test_year=pl.Series([*map(str, test_years), "Mean"])
    )
    return out.select("test_year", "AUC", "NDCG@1%", "NDCG@2%", "NDCG@3%")
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
def train_logit(features: pl.DataFrame, test_year: int, gap: int = 2):
    test_date = (
        test_dates
        .filter(pl.col("test_year") == test_year)
        .select("test_date")
        .item()
    )
    aaers_local = get_aaers(test_date=str(test_date))
    data_train_local = (
        aaers_local
        .join(features, on=["gvkey", "fyear"], how="right")
        .filter(pl.col("fyear") <= test_year - gap)
        .with_columns(
            misstate=pl.col("misstate")
            .fill_null(False).cast(pl.Int8)
        )
    )
    fm = LogisticRegression(max_iter=5000)
    fm.fit(
        data_train_local.select(X_vars),
        data_train_local[y_var],
    )
    return fm

def test_logit(features: pl.DataFrame, fm, test_year: int):
    data_test = (
        features
        .join(
            aaer_long.select("gvkey", "fyear", "p_aaer"),
            on=["gvkey", "fyear"],
            how="left",
        )
        .with_columns(
            misstate=pl.col("p_aaer").is_not_null().cast(pl.Int8)
        )
        .filter(pl.col("fyear") == test_year)
    )
    score = predict_proba_series(
        fm,
        data_test.select(X_vars),
        name="score",
    ).to_numpy()
    return {
        "score": score,
        "predicted": (score > 0.5).astype(np.int8),
        "response": data_test["misstate"].to_numpy(),
    }

def fit_test_logit(x: int, features: pl.DataFrame, gap: int = 2):
    fm = train_logit(features=features, test_year=x, gap=gap)
    return test_logit(features=features, fm=fm, test_year=x)

results_logit = [
    fit_test_logit(year, features=features)
    for year in test_years
]
```
